title: The Fort Myers band
summary: Reel three opens; he did not know the Fort Myers well and suggests asking Cats.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Okay, reel three, Albert Artigue, December the 15th, 1961. What about the Fort Myers? Did you ever hear them?

Yeah, the Fort Myers, they played around the time I was playing. I didn't know them very well. Cats played with them. They come a little after me, after I quit playing, I think, because I heard of them, and I know Cats played with them. We'll get to ask Cats about them. Yeah, you'd have to ask Cats, but he remembers them, I know.
